correctness.rationale: The admissible blocks are exactly 10 singletons, 30 pairs corresponding to edges of T5, and 10 open-neighborhood triples; no larger blocks exist. The disjoint triple-class cases (0,1,2) are exhaustive and disjoint. Exact matching vertex-deletion recurrence gives m(T5)=(1,30,285,980,1020,144), the common seven-vertex residual vector (1,15,54,40), and the four-cycle vector (1,4,2), yielding all seven coefficients. Independently, complete RGS enumeration of 115975 set partitions reproduces all seven counts. The 15 disjoint triple-center pairs each admit two doubleton completions; S5 acts transitively. Six disjoint rational sign intervals each contain one polynomial root; degree six proves all simple and negative. The included actual source files were run and their exact outputs checked.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is the smallest nontrivial highly symmetric cubic Moore graph and a standard test graph for total domination; class-domination colorings are a motivated coloring-plus-monitoring structure. Determining every unlabeled admissible partition sharpens the known scalar minimum and yields a complete natural enumerator. The 30 optimum partitions admit a uniform five-point geometric description and a single automorphism orbit. Unexpectedly, the full rank polynomial has an exactly certified real-rooted factor, hence log-concave coefficients. The result is finite but complete for this canonical object, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine numerical recomputation of a known table.
